name: Sandy Cunningham

bio.statement: King City's council bio page lists Cunningham's term as expiring at the end of 2026.
Cunningham's pamphlet statement says she is a current, appointed King City councilor.
Cunningham's pamphlet statement lists a background in legal administration, operations and financial oversight.
bio.excerpt: Legal Administration - managed operations, procedures, and financial oversight for legal organizations

bio.statement: Cunningham's pamphlet statement lists business administration studies at Portland Community College.

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Cunningham pledges to protect taxpayer dollars through responsible budgeting.
positions.excerpt: Protect taxpayer dollars through responsible budgeting.

positions.statement: Cunningham's pamphlet statement supports transparent and accountable local government.
positions.excerpt: Promote transparent and accountable local government.

positions.statement: Cunningham's pamphlet statement supports public safety and high-quality city services.
positions.excerpt: Support public safety and maintain high-quality city services.

collection_notes: King City council bios page lists seven councilors: Rachel Kazmierski, Stephen Gearhart, Vince Arditi, Sandra Cunningham, Gary Mitchell, Linda Quanstrom, Jan Tysoe. The city's candidate-filings page lists completed filings for Dirksen, Cunningham, Gearhart, Suesserman (spelled 'Susserman') and Buehner, and James M Minor as a prospective petition. Step 4/5 searches returned only older (2016-2023) Pamplin/WW coverage or other King Cities; not used to keep treatment equal. Listed as Sandra Cunningham on the city site.
